correctness.rationale: Closed SIR final-size root is unique since the strictly concave fixed-point residual crosses once from positive to negative; its slope at the root gives \(0<\mathcal R s<1\). Implicit differentiation yields A_R=A s/(1-Rs). Substitution proves \(Q′/Q=(g_*-\mathcal R s h)/(1-\mathcal R s)\), strictly positive to the right of the reproduction-ratio optimizer. The uniform exponential estimate ensures full positivity for sufficiently large transmission. The 30:1 explicit example uses strict rational exponential bounds. The analytic proof covers continuous u and asymptotic beta0; 522 independent checker assertions corroborate arithmetic and ODE consistency.

value.rationale: Distinct policy objectives are motivated by simultaneous burden versus cumulative infectious person-time, which controls duration-weighted utilization in this model. The universal strict optimum ordering and the large-transmission reversal show a qualitative and all-parameter structural distinction, with an exact bounded example; the result is not merely an evaluation of one arbitrary parameter case. It provides a diagnostic for comparing budget recommendations from peak-only models.
